articles.summary: Acquisition positions Servier as a leader in pediatric low-grade glioma and expands its pipeline with programs targeting adult and pediatric cancers with high unmet needs Transaction represents total equity value of approximately $2.5 billion SURESNES, France and BRISBANE, Calif., March 06, 2026
articles.title: Servier and Day One Biopharmaceuticals announce acquisition to expand Servier’s rare oncology portfolio
